newsitem.title: POLAND: Mostostal-E seeks listing for five firms.
newsitem.headline: Mostostal-E seeks listing for five firms.

text.p: Polish steel trader Mostostal Export SA will seek the Securities Commission's approval next month for listing five subsidiaries on the bourse, the firm's deputy president said on Wednesday.

"By the end of June, we will submit to the Securities Commission issue prospectuses of five companies. They are Instal-Lublin, Delia, Compensa, Budpol Wroclaw and Zaklady Elektroniczne Gornictwa," Wojciech Rzepka told Reuters.
He said the issues will be made through public subscriptions.
Rzepka added shareholders have approved increasing Instal-Lublin's capital by 200,000 zlotys to one million zlotys and Delia's capital by one million zlotys to two million zlotys.
